newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares jump, powered by Lek.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares jump, powered by Lek.

text.p: Slovenian shares rose 1.59 percent on Tuesday, pulled up by 7.42 percent surge in the A issue of drug company Lek, traders said.
* The 11-share SBI index rose 24.84 percent to 1,583.7.
* Lek's A issue was the most actively traded, rising to 30,400 tolars on volume of 10,191 shares for total turnover of 296.8 million tolars. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana Newsroom, 386-61-126-3644
